baseline_admission_gates.timing: both gates fixed before any new trained-arm outcome

hard_prohibitions: No K1/K2/K4 scientific training in parallel with this screen.
No optimizer-window manipulation in the predicate basis screen.
No post-outcome margin, seed, prompt, threshold, or action-set changes.
No claim that success proves CFE in general.
No automatic combination-mechanism rescue if dispositions fail.

parent_evidence.post_hoc_ceiling: motivates this screen but does not confirm its mechanism

policy_task.name: POLICY_FACTORIZED
policy_task.purpose: test whether policy mapping is independently learnable without boundary inference

PREDICATE_IDENTIFYING_BASIS.role: identifying basis spanning safe slack, equality, near overflow, and farther overflow

PREDICATE_NARROW_SLICE.role: embodies the v1.0 boundary-support defect without the action-policy task

predicate_matching: same four capacity/incoming contexts at each paired block index
same per-seed sequence order across paired arms
no mode or action-policy target in predicate task
no explicit inequality formula in learner-visible predicate prompt
predicate learner-visible target is opaque condition_z; word overflow and inequality formula are absent

requires_all: predicate identifying-basis mean paired accuracy delta over narrow slice > 0
identifying basis wins at least 4 of 6 paired seeds
identifying basis improves the combined out-of-original-support margins (-7,-3,-1,+3,+7)
effect is not produced solely by output-format compliance

trigger_any: identifying basis does not have positive mean paired delta
identifying basis wins fewer than 4 of 6 paired seeds
any apparent benefit is confined to the old {0,+1} support

NEXT_BRANCH.if_policy_not_learnable: stop joint CFE interpretation for bounded transport and investigate policy/output semantics before geometry
NEXT_BRANCH.if_predicate_basis_supported_and_policy_: build a separately preregistered JOINT_IDENTIFYING composition screen; do not jump directly to K1/K2/K4
NEXT_BRANCH.if_predicate_basis_weakened: demote wrong-basis mechanism and prioritize optimizer-field/horizon or unmodeled mechanism

requires_all: mean policy accuracy across six trained seeds >= 0.95
at least 5 of 6 policy seeds have accuracy >= 0.90
each action class is above 0.80 pooled accuracy

questions.POLICY: Can the same learner reliably learn the mode-conditioned action policy when overflow truth is supplied explicitly and arithmetic identification is removed?
questions.PREDICATE: Does replacing the original under-resolved {0,+1} boundary slice with an identifying numerical basis improve learned transfer of an opaque condition_z predicate when sequence density and update-field structure are held fixed?
